claim: ROUTE-0162 /login lazy-loads LoginRoute/Zn. Only workspaceRecovery equal to the literal true enables recovery. Gn uses this flag to disable desktop-auth handoff and select post-success replacement navigation to the qualified home return path rather than the normal welcome path. This does not prove project/history restoration.

The host login-method selector distinguishes loading, error, unsupported and ready. Explicit null requirements falls back to a successfully read config forced_login_method; an absent/undefined requirements field is an error; present requirements must contain allowedLoginMethods and pass E.safeParse. api/chatgpt are allowed-method values, not product modes. The blocked/loading presenter exposes Retry, refetching requirements and config; it does not silently enable a forbidden method.

Gn gives Bedrock finalization/warning state priority, then pending gateway stages other than chatgpt. Non-ready policy or no allowed methods renders the requirements presenter. Missing prior-onboarding context renders a spinner. Only a ready allowed policy and that context enable its actual sign-in callbacks.

The browser sign-in callback first cancels a node-owned pending login, or aborts and clears its own pending controller on a repeated invocation. Otherwise it requires prior-onboarding context and ready chatgpt permission. It creates an AbortController and passes its signal to rt. Unmount aborts the local controller unless node-owned login survives; losing method permission also aborts it. The pending presenter reuses the callback as Cancel and may expose Copy sign-in link.

Browser intents are parameters: signin, signup, google, microsoft and other-account modify screen_hint, connection or prompt. The first-party URL adapter preserves malformed input on catch, wraps /codex/desktop-auth when enabled, and supplies qualified version/workspace/login-hint/stable-id and streamlined-login parameters. Recovery disables desktop-auth handoff. These strings and the default chatgpt.com origin do not establish a ChatGPT-only product feature.

Browser completion checks abort before processing success. Success removes the exact account-info query and applies recovery versus normal onboarding state/navigation. Failure and exceptions produce the selected analytics/error toast; AbortError has a separate no-toast branch. Finally clears only the matching local pending controller. Actual browser/auth/token effects remain delegated to rt and the browser bridge.

API-key submission trims the input, rejects empty/pending/missing-context/disallowed cases, creates a local AbortController and calls loginWithApiKey with the key only. It checks abort after the await and suppresses handling of aborted failures. No AbortSignal is passed to loginWithApiKey, so local cancellation does not prove backend request cancellation. Reset clears the form; pending cleanup aborts its local controller.

Bedrock discovery calls account/bedrock/discover with an empty object and selects profiles, an active profile, environment availability and region. The controller uses a generation counter to discard stale discovery updates; Back advances it. The selected unsupported-operation error disables AWS-credential support. There is no discovery AbortSignal or proof that Back cancels the backend request.

Bedrock submission preserves four parameterized methods: profile/environment use account/bedrock/setup; accessKeys uses account/login/start type amazonBedrockAccessKeys; apiKey uses account/login/start type amazonBedrock. The form has required/nonempty fields and pending disablement, trims region/profile and maps an empty session token to null. Success awaits local app-server restart and then the GovCloud check. Selected requests have no cancellation signal; credential persistence is external.

The GovCloud checker returns warning for checked GovCloud, null for checked non-GovCloud, and null for unsupported non-us-gov regions; other errors/unknown outcomes are unverified. The guidance dialog has no close button, ignores outside clicks and prevents the selected Escape behavior. Unverified permits Check again; Acknowledge and Retry are guarded while checking. Continue clears finalization state and follows the appropriate recovery/onboarding path.

Initial J9 resolves to Program function wXa. It preserves only an accepted /browser/handoff identity, with thread_id/tab_id and optional connection_thread_id. sWa rejects a nonmatching prefix or any hash; oWa validates getAll arrays with the initialized schema. Only one nested next is considered from login/welcome/select-workspace paths. cWa normalizes the handoff query and omits connection_thread_id when equal. Arbitrary next destinations are not directly returned; current live stored location remains unobserved.

The saved root selector distinguishes pending Bedrock/gateway login, loading auth, required/missing auth or a missing ChatGPT token, eligibility, gateway readiness, override and onboarding/workspace roots. DXa keeps a login path with workspaceRecovery=true in place before normal redirect selection. XXa dispatches app/onboarding window mode and can render the gateway login fallback; these window/onboarding decisions do not write the client Codex/ChatGPT product-mode store.

The active sign-in URL prefers a gateway pending URL over the local auth URL. Copy delegates to the clipboard helper only when a URL exists and shows its success toast only for a truthy copy result. Other-method panels, API-key entry, provider buttons and browser-session suggestions are conditional presentation; no browser-session or clipboard contents were read during this analysis.

Controller state is local: browser/API pending handles, Bedrock detection/submission/errors, panel visibility and API-key text. Global onboarding/Bedrock state and query invalidation remain interface writes. This selected controller does not prove token authority, credential storage, cross-window ownership, account isolation or restart durability.

A logo action separately mounts the local Snake component, creates/resumes an AudioContext and hides the normal header until exit. This adjacent first-party user goal is retained as an explicit candidate; the game implementation is not analyzed or counted as an authentication operation in this batch.

Retain this login/recovery goal with mode unknown: source authentication methods named chatgpt/api and Codex desktop-auth routing are not an exclusive product-mode guard. Proposed modules own the controller, managed method policy, Bedrock adapter and browser URL adapter. Third-party query/UI/schema/runtime implementations remain package dependencies.

The scoped goal is distinct from FSC-0390 logout, FSC-0152 remote-host login, FSC-0132 connected-app authentication and FSC-0491 onboarding project registration. Reuse those adjacent interfaces; do not claim that successful login itself registers or restores projects.
